decisions.ask: The late-fee code and its test are written and pass, but the loans file also holds a change I did not make, so I committed nothing.

recommended.door: Commit only the new late-fee file and its test; the loans file stays untouched and uncommitted.
recommended.why: This is a judgment: it keeps the finished work safe and leaves your loans change exactly as it is.
recommended.reverses_if: that loans change belongs with the late-fee work, or you want it committed first.

others.what_it_does: You commit or set aside the loans change yourself and tell me; the late-fee commit then goes ahead.

decisions.if_none: Nothing is committed; the new files stay in the tree and the loans file is untouched.
